Path B: r2-motif-path-b-phase114-mayig.py over outputs/phase114_full_seal_translations.json (exit 0 after one fixed None-guard rerun; first run exit 1 on rows with null text_code in the mayig-mapping leg only).
replication.outcome: EXACT AGREEMENT on every computable count: seals-with-sign and token counts for all 16 signs, per-site counts, and all numerical distributions. The mayig P-to-M mapping leg returned no mapping for M012/M059/M391 (only 27 distinct canonical grapheme ids are populated in indus_open.jsonl) and is recorded as a failed third leg, not used.
